title: The Penalty Charge a Ridgecrest RxSecure Relief Is Worked Out On
content:
On a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan the monthly penalty a relief is worked out on is read off the member's own premium account wherever the account carries penalty charges, and off the published figures only where it does not.

| What the premium account carries | The monthly penalty the relief is worked out on |
| --- | --- |
| A penalty charge larger than the latest one stands on the account, and 2 or more penalty charges stand on it | the largest penalty charged |
| No penalty charge larger than the latest one stands on the account, and at least 1 penalty charge stands on it | the latest penalty charged |
| Neither of the above | the figure the national base beneficiary premium and the plan's penalty rate give for the months without creditable coverage the enrollment carries |

## The conditions in their parts

The first row is compound: the account must carry a penalty charge larger than the latest one, **and** the count of penalty charges standing on it must be 2 or more. Where the account carries 2 or more penalty charges but none of them is larger than the latest, the first row is not met and the second is: the latest penalty charged is the figure. Where the account carries exactly 1 penalty charge, that charge is by definition the latest and none is larger than it, so the second row applies.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical accounts

- An account carrying 2 penalty charges, of a hypothetical 4.40 USD and then 3.20 USD: a charge larger than the latest stands on it and the count is 2, so the relief is worked out on the largest penalty charged, 4.40 USD.
- The same two charges posted in the other order, 3.20 USD and then 4.40 USD: no charge is larger than the latest, and at least 1 stands, so the relief is worked out on the latest penalty charged, 4.40 USD.
- An account carrying 1 penalty charge of a hypothetical 3.20 USD: the count is below 2, so the first row cannot apply; at least 1 charge stands, so the relief is worked out on that latest charge of 3.20 USD.
- An account carrying no penalty charge at all: neither row is met, and the figure is the one the published premium and rate give for the uncovered months the enrollment carries.
